description: Find cities by name. Each city includes its id, IANA time zone, and country. Use when a city name is ambiguous or the user wants to know which time zone a city is in. The query is not repeated.

query.description: City name, such as Bern or Zürich. Spelling and accents are flexible. A city id such as gn:2657896 is also accepted.

name: search_cities

alternatives.description: Other cities that matched the same name, after the best-ranked city was chosen. The order is the site search order: match, then priority, then population.

title: Search cities
